source: Single home for model-council seats. Edit this file to swap a model. SKILL.md (both trees) and model-council-console.html read it. Do not copy slugs back into the skill. Chair is always the live session host and is never picked.

picker.note: HTML one-shot picker every run (law A). Count 2-5, then panel, then auditor. Host family greyed. Same-vendor panel refused. Pick file is one-use. All doors OpenRouter. Verdict in chat only.

models.name: Claude Opus 5.5
models.blurb: Anthropic's flagship, succeeding Opus 5. Default chair when Claude is the session host (this engine). Pickable as an OpenRouter panel/auditor door when someone else hosts — greyed out of picks while it IS the host.
models.note: OpenRouter id anthropic/claude-opus-5.5. When this engine is host: door is THIS ENGINE, not a pick. Confirm Opus 5.5 + max on the live session. The console greys the host family. Intelligence 64 is a hand estimate on the old AA v4.1 scale; AA moved to v4.2 in October, so newer published scores are not comparable.

models.name: GPT-6 Astra
models.blurb: OpenAI flagship via OpenRouter. Long-horizon analysis, software engineering, and agentic work. Succeeds GPT-5.6 Sol. Row key stays sol so host greying still matches.
models.note: OpenRouter id openai/gpt-6-astra. Effort high. Not Codex in this council — every door is OpenRouter. Intelligence 55 is AA Intelligence Index 54.7, rounded.

models.name: Kimi K3.1 Pro
models.blurb: Moonshot AI's flagship open-weight multimodal reasoner, post-trained successor to Kimi K3 — long-horizon coding and agentic work.
models.note: Runs at max (operator-set). OpenRouter id is moonshotai/kimi-k3.1-pro. Intelligence 61 is a hand estimate on the old AA v4.1 scale; AA moved to v4.2 in October, so newer published scores are not comparable.

models.name: Qwen3.8 Max 0902
models.blurb: Alibaba's Qwen3.8 Max, the 0902 snapshot — multimodal reasoning for coding, visual understanding, and agentic workflows.
models.note: Max is the product name. Native reasoning ceiling is xhigh. The undated qwen/qwen3.8-max slug is gone from OpenRouter; use the dated one. Intelligence 58 is a hand estimate on the old AA v4.1 scale; AA moved to v4.2 in October, so newer published scores are not comparable.

models.name: Muse Wonder
models.blurb: Meta's frontier reasoning model for complex agentic work. Succeeds Muse Spark 1.3 on this panel.
models.note: Runs at xhigh (operator-set). Muse Spark 1.3 is still on OpenRouter if you want the cheaper seat back. Intelligence 60 is a hand estimate on the old AA v4.1 scale; AA moved to v4.2 in October, so newer published scores are not comparable.

models.name: Gemini 4 Argon
models.blurb: Google's flagship reasoning model for complex software engineering and autonomous multi-step agents. Replaces Gemini 3.8 Flash on this panel.
models.note: Runs at high. Gemini 3.8 Flash is still on OpenRouter if you want the cheap seat back. Intelligence 62 is a hand estimate on the old AA v4.1 scale; AA moved to v4.2 in October, so newer published scores are not comparable.

models.name: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813
models.blurb: GA release of DeepSeek V4 Pro — large-scale mixture-of-experts. On the bench until seated as panel or auditor.
models.note: OpenRouter id is the dated slug deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro-0813, not the older deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro. Effort max (same ceiling as the previous Pro door). Not a live panel seat.

models.name: GLM 5.3
models.blurb: Z.ai's successor to GLM 5.2 — coding and long-horizon agents. Reasoning is always on. On the bench until seated as panel or auditor.
models.note: Runs at max (provider default; also supports low/high). Reasoning cannot be disabled. Not a live panel seat.

models.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
models.blurb: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, the 17 October snapshot — sparse MoE, cheap and fast. On the bench until seated.
models.note: OpenRouter id is the dated slug deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017. Effort max until you set another. Two DeepSeek rows in the pool is fine; a run should not seat both if vendor diversity is the point. Not a live panel seat. Intelligence 50 is a hand estimate on the old AA v4.1 scale; AA moved to v4.2 in October, so newer published scores are not comparable.

models.name: Grok 4.7
models.blurb: Catalog auditor label only. This run's auditor is whoever the picker names. Took no part in the debate: a cold read of the chair's synthesis. Pickable as panel or auditor.
models.note: OpenRouter id is x-ai/grok-4.7. Effort high. Not locked: the picker chooses the auditor from any model with auditor in pickableAs. Default only. Intelligence 62 is a hand estimate on the old AA v4.1 scale; AA moved to v4.2 in October, so newer published scores are not comparable.
